topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Finding my childhood teddy bear at a yard sale was like stumbling upon a piece of forgotten history. I recognized him immediately, worn and a little faded, but there was no mistaking that patched ear and the button nose that had lost its shine. It’s amazing how he survived, tucked away or passed around until he ended up here. Holding him, I felt a gentle flood of memories—long car rides, stormy nights, and every silly adventure we had. Without hesitation, I paid for him, feeling a quiet joy in bringing him back home, like welcoming an old friend after a long time away.
